text:
Nora (Product): quick follow-up from the Q&A: can we lock a concise set of target windows + "go/no-go" acceptance criteria for API v2, Console GA, and Optimize cost suggestions so partners have something to plan to?

Elle (CEO): short answer: yes, we can publish targets but mark them as provisional. propose a one-pager timeline + acceptance checklist this week.

Marco (Eng): API v2 status: feature freeze done. remaining work: single kernel perf patch + quantization validation. rollout plan: 7d canary, 7d ramp, opt-in, GA if no P1s and perf gates pass. target window: canary early Aug, GA late Sep.

Zoe (Platform): Console GA blockers: tenant migration tooling and RBAC parity. plan: internal dry-run late Aug, invited beta mid-Sep, GA early Oct. ops requires rollback-tested runbook and 48h post-migration monitoring.

Finn (Solutions): partners need a clear matrix: which flags/features are in beta vs GA and sample migration scripts. product should publish this with SDK snippets.

Nora (Product): draft targets (provisional):
- API v2: canary ~ 2026-08-08, GA target ~ 2026-09-22
- Console: invited beta ~ 2026-09-15, GA target ~ 2026-10-07
- Optimize (cost tips): opt-in preview ~ 2026-09-03, public beta ~ 2026-09-25

Marco (Eng): perf acceptance (API v2): P99 within 1.25x baseline, token cost delta < 1.15x, no memory growth after 72h soak.

Zoe (Platform): migration acceptance (Console): successful dry-run on 3 tenants, rollback script validated, runbook < 30m per tenant, 48h monitoring green.

Finn (Solutions): partner comms: feature-flag names, SDK deprecations, sample logs, and a short migration checklist video.

Nora (Product): action items: 1) Nora -> publish one-pager + feature matrix; 2) Marco -> final perf checklist; 3) Zoe -> schedule dry-runs + runbook; 4) Finn -> partner FAQ + demo steps. I'll post the links in this thread by Thursday EOD.

update-bot: scheduled: canary-reserve job queued for 2026-08-04 09:00 UTC.

Elle (CEO): decision: publish targets with "provisional" label, and commit to a canary update ~10 days after canary start. please keep updates short in this thread so partners have one clear link. :white_check_mark:
